SELECT 
  p.name,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.trip_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.member_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id), 1) AS percentage_with_trips
FROM plan p
LEFT JOIN member m ON p.plan_id = m.plan_id
LEFT JOIN trip t ON m.member_id = t.member_id
GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.name;
